propositions: A CI harness must measure before/after raw-output distributions across (provider, model, directive) cells to validate that the sentinel directive increases parse success and collapses layout class to 100% prose

The harness must run n=10 on two production prompts (agentic transcript with quoted record, single-shot contract step) per cell, capture raw replies as artifacts, and score parse success and layout-class rates deterministically against golden fixtures

Missing API credentials must record cells as 'unmeasured' and skip without failing; call budget must be enforced before any network call; scorer must be fully unit-testable offline on committed golden replies
The workflow_dispatch job must sync --extra dev (pytest + pydantic-ai providers), register in test_workflow_names.py, and rebase onto main to inherit Git-version-floor gate

Live measurement confirms sentinel directive raises parse success on all arms (anthropic 8→11/20, bedrock 9→11/20, openai 18→19/20) and collapses fenced/multi_object layouts to 0 on anthropic and bedrock
Per-arm secret scoping creates 'unmeasured' cells for providers whose keys are absent in that arm; the union across 3 workflow arms covers all provider cells
